recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up male portrait against a soft blue radial gradient background, featuring thin white geometric line accents and a high-contrast pairing of clean sans-serif and expressive handwritten typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head in the upper third
Text positioned in the right-side negative space
Color coordination between the pocket square and the script lettering
Thin white lines framing the subject to create depth
coreInvariants: Combination of geometric and organic graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark, textured beard form the central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the display typography, then follows the diagonal white lines toward the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample blue space on the left and right sides to accommodate text and graphic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue to light cyan radial gradient (Background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep burgundy/maroon (Script text and pocket square)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white (Sans-serif text and geometric lines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key background with high-saturation accents and low-value dark tones in the subject's hair and shirt.
paletteRestrictions: Warm accents must be deep red or burgundy

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of geometric sans-serif and fluid, expressive script.
letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif: Uniform stroke weight, open apertures, geometric circles for 'O' and 'C'.
Script: Varying pressure, long ascenders and descenders, 30-degree upward slant.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'G' features a large, expressive loop
Script 'P' has an elongated descender that acts as a visual divider
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid geometry and organic handwriting.

preserve: The upward slant of the script
The wide tracking of the sans-serif
The burgundy color for the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean uppercase display style.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Custom brush script or 'Signature' style font
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, personal feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with styled brown hair and a beard, wearing a dark patterned button-down shirt with a red pocket square. The background is a soft radial gradient from light blue in the center to a slightly darker blue at the edges. Include four thin white diagonal lines entering from the corners of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white with wide tracking in the upper right. Below it, add a large, expressive handwritten script in burgundy, slanted upwards at a 15-degree angle.

verificationChecks: Is the script text burgundy to match the pocket square?
Are the white lines thin and geometric?
Is the sans-serif text uppercase and widely spaced?
Does the script text have long, expressive descenders?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for color harmony between script and pocket square
Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the radial gradient is smooth without banding
Confirm the geometric lines are perfectly straight
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Radial Gradient + Geometric Accents + (Geometric Sans + Expressive Script) Pairing
